use_case: Research and due diligence: ask once, verify everywhere

release.label: Alphabet Q3 2026 earnings release, Exhibit 99.1 (copy with 2 planted conflicts)

call.label: Alphabet Q3 2026 earnings call, prepared remarks (video, no transcript)

grading.value: within 0.5% of the answer, or abs_tol in the question's unit; trap questions correct only if null
grading.conflict: conflict flag must be true exactly for the planted questions, and the release must be cited with its planted value
grading.doc_citation: quote must appear verbatim in the cited source (whitespace, table pipes and quote styles ignored) and contain one anchor set for that source
grading.call_citation: timestamp within call_tol_s of the reference time where the figure is spoken (reference: data/part2/call_reference, three model transcripts agree within 10 s)
grading.unverifiable: a document quote not found verbatim, or a call citation for a figure that is not spoken in the prepared remarks, or a call timestamp outside the tolerance
